# Outbound — Persona 1: Startup Founders

Who: pre-seed/seed founders with a landing page that undersells the product,
a waitlist with no conversion path, or investor-demo deadlines.
Find them: Hacker News "Show HN" launches, Product Hunt recent launches,
YC startup directory, X build-in-public threads.

## Personalization variables (fill ALL before sending — ~3 min research)

- `[FirstName]` — founder's first name
- `[Startup]` — startup name
- `[ProductOneLiner]` — what they do, in their own words (from their site)
- `[SpecificObservation]` — ONE concrete thing you saw (e.g. "your pricing page 404s from the mobile nav")
- `[ConcreteFix]` — ONE concrete fix tied to their goal (e.g. "a one-section demo-booking block above the fold")
- `[TheirGoal]` — demo bookings / waitlist signups / investor credibility
- `[DayOption]` — two specific days ("Tue or Thu")

## Anti-spam rules (all 4 templates)

1. First two lines must contain `[SpecificObservation]` — never send without it.
2. One follow-up max, 4–5 business days later, then drop the prospect.
3. Every message includes an easy out ("worth it, or should I close this out?").
4. Max 10 new prospects/day across all channels. No sequences, no automation.
5. Only cite numbers you actually measured. Never invent load times or conversions.

---

## 1A. Email — the demo-gap teardown

Subject: quick idea for `[Startup]`'s `[demo/waitlist]` flow

> Hi `[FirstName]`,
>
> Tried `[ProductOneLiner]` via your site — `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I build fast landing pages for early startups where one action matters:
> `[TheirGoal]`. One idea for you: `[ConcreteFix]` — small change, and I'd bet
> it lifts after-hours inquiries without touching your product.
>
> I do $5, 60-min idea calls: we map the page, I give you a fixed quote and
> the plan is yours either way. Open `[DayOption]`?
>
> If this isn't a priority, just say so — no follow-up storm. One check-in
> max from me.
>
> — `[YourName]`, `[Studio]` · `[portfolio/GitHub link]`

## 1B. LinkedIn DM — short, founder-to-founder (send only with a note + after viewing profile; no pitch in the connection request itself)

> Hi `[FirstName]` — founder to founder: I looked at `[Startup]`'s site and
> spotted `[SpecificObservation]`. Fix I'd try: `[ConcreteFix]`.
>
> I build one-pagers for startups chasing `[TheirGoal]`, fixed price upfront.
> Happy to sketch it on a $5 call (60 min, plan's yours either way) — worth a
> look, or should I leave you to it?

## 1C. Discord/Slack DM — community context only (only where DMs are welcome and you've been a visible helper first)

> hey `[FirstName]` — saw your `[launch/post]` for `[Startup]`, congrats on
> shipping. One thing I noticed: `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I do landing pages for startups — `[ConcreteFix]` is the kind of tweak I'd
> make first for `[TheirGoal]`. If you ever want a second pair of eyes, I do
> $5 idea calls where you keep the plan. Zero pressure either way — just
> thought it might help the launch.

## 1D. Follow-up (ONE, 4–5 business days later, any channel — never double up across channels)

Subject: Re: quick idea for `[Startup]`'s `[demo/waitlist]` flow

> Hi `[FirstName]` — checking in once: is `[ConcreteFix]` for `[Startup]`
> still interesting, or should I close this out?
>
> Either way is fine. If timing's the issue, happy to reconnect when
> `[TheirGoal]` becomes the priority.
>
> — `[YourName]`

(No second follow-up. Log outcome, move to the next 5 prospects.)
